blocks.text: Aap jaante hain ke saalon se organisms (jandaron) ko kingdoms mein baantne ke liye kai tareeqe (schemes) pesh kiye gaye hain. Chapter 1 mein aap ne parha ke Robert H. Whittaker ka five-kingdom classification system biology mein recommend kiya jata hai. Yeh system organisms ko aise comprehensive (har pehlu ko shamil karne wale) tareeqe se classify karta hai jo un ki evolutionary history (irtiqa ki kahani) ko zahir karta hai. Is system ke mutabiq tamam prokaryotes ek alag kingdom, yani kingdom Monera, mein rakhe gaye hain.

blocks.title: Yaad karein (Recalling)
blocks.text: Robert H. Whittaker ne zindagi ki paanch kingdoms pesh keen: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Pehli kingdom (Monera) mein prokaryotes aate hain aur baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

Pichhle das saal mein molecular studies ne five-kingdom system mein sanjeeda flaws (khamiyan) dikhayi hain. Chapter 1 mein aap ne yeh bhi parha ke aksar biologists is ki jagah ek naya system, three-domain system, lana pasand karte hain. Yeh molecular studies se milne wale data se zyada mel khata hai.

Aap jaante hain ke bacteria woh prokaryotes hain jinhen un ki apni domain, yani domain Bacteria, mein rakha gaya hai. Is chapter mein hum bacterial cell ki tafseeli structure (banawat) parhenge. Hum bacteria ki ahmiyat bhi parhenge.

Bacteria ek diverse (kai qisam wala) group hain aur sab ki organization unicellular prokaryotic hai: in mein membrane bounded organelles nahin hote, yahan tak ke saaf (well-defined) nucleus bhi nahin hota. In ki cellular organization sab se saada (simplest) hai.

blocks.alt: Ek rod-shaped bacterium lambai mein khula hua. Bahar se andar: capsule, cell wall aur cell membrane, phir cytoplasm jis mein ribosomes, ek plasmid ka chhalla (ring), ek mesosome aur nucleoid jis mein DNA hai. Satah se pili bahar nikle hain aur ek sire (pole) se flagellum nikalta hai. Labels: Capsule, Cell wall, Cell membrane, DNA, Pilus, Nucleoid (containing DNA), Cytoplasm, Ribosome, Mesosome, Plasmid, Flagellum.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.1: Ek aam (generalized) bacterium ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 2.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahar se andar teen tehain (layers) dekhein: halki hari capsule, neeli cell wall aur narangi cell membrane. Membrane ki andar ki taraf mudi hui teh (infolding) mesosome hai. Darmiyan ka halka jamuni ilaqa nucleoid hai aur us ke andar ki gol lipti lakeer bacterium ka ek hi circular DNA hai. Chhota peela chhalla plasmid hai, lal nuqtay ribosomes (70S) hain, chhote baal jaise dhaage pili hain aur lambi lehrdaar dum flagellum hai.
Cell Wall (cell ki deewar)

Yeh bacterial cell ki plasma membrane ke gird ek sakht (rigid) deewar hai. Bacterial cell wall ka sab se bara hissa ek khaas macromolecule (bohat bara molecule) hai jise peptidoglycan ya murein kehte hain. Yeh lambi glycan (polysaccharide) chain se bana hai jo chhote peptide tukron se cross-link (aapas mein jura hua) hoti hai (Figure 2.2). Is ki miqdar mukhtalif bacteria mein alag alag hoti hai. Cell wall mein lipids bhi hote hain jo peptidoglycan se jure hote hain.

blocks.alt: Peptidoglycan ka gend (ball) model: bari gulabi aur narangi gendon ki teen zanjeerein (glycan) saath saath chalti hain. Har doosri glycan unit se chaar chhoti rangeen gendon (amino acids) ki khari qatar neeche chhote jamuni motiyon ki lari tak jati hai, aur yun tehain aapas mein jur kar jaal (mesh) banati hain. Labels: Glycan, Amino acids.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.2: Peptidoglycan ka molecular model (kitab ki Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bari gulabi aur narangi gendein sugar units hain jo mil kar lambi glycan (polysaccharide) zanjeer banati hain. Chhoti rangeen gendon ki khari qataarein amino acids ke chhote peptide tukre hain jo zanjeeron ko aapas mein jorte (cross-link karte) hain. Isi jaal ki wajah se cell wall mazboot rehti hai aur bacterium ki shakal qaim rehti hai.

blocks.title: Gram’s staining
blocks.text: Sir Hans Christian Gram ne Gram’s staining ki technique banayi. Gram-positive bacteria purple (jamni) rang lete hain kyunke woh violet dye ko apne andar rok lete hain. Gram-negative bacteria violet dye nahin rokte, is liye woh apne asal rang mein nazar aate hain. (Lab mein aakhir mein aam tor par safranin jaisa doosra rang (counterstain) lagaya jata hai, is liye Gram-negative bacteria pink dikhte hain.)

Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria mein cell wall ki composition (kis cheez se bani hai) kaafi mukhtalif hai. Gram-positive bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan ki moti teh (layer) hoti hai aur lipid kam hota hai. Jabke Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan ki patli teh hoti hai.

Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall mein ek outer membrane (bahar wali jhilli) hoti hai jo lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins se bani hai. Yeh outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko bohat si antibiotics ke khilaf resistant (asar na hone dene wala) banati hai. Is mein porin naam ka protein hota hai jo khaas molecules ke liye pore (soorakh) ka kaam karta hai. Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall mein periplasmic space (peptidoglycan layer aur cell membrane ke darmiyan ki jagah) Gram-positive se zyada hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do walls ke hisse saath saath. Gram-Positive: motiyon ki chaar tehon wala mota peptidoglycan, periplasmic space, aur cell membrane jis mein ek protein hai. Gram-Negative: outer membrane jis par lipopolysaccharide hai aur jis ke aar paar ek porin hai, lipoprotein jo use patli peptidoglycan teh se jorta hai, periplasmic space, aur cell membrane jis mein ek protein hai. Labels: Peptidoglycan, Periplasmic space, Cell membrane, Protein, Outer membrane, Lipopolysaccharide, Porin, Lipoprotein.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall ki tarkeeb (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen (left) taraf Gram-positive wall mein peptidoglycan ki moti teh hai, is liye yeh violet dye rok leti hai. Daen (right) taraf Gram-negative wall mein peptidoglycan patla hai aur us ke upar ek outer membrane hai (lipopolysaccharide aur lipoprotein wali). Peela porin is membrane mein darwaze (pore) ka kaam karta hai. Dono mein periplasmic space peptidoglycan aur cell membrane ke darmiyan ki jagah hai.

blocks.text: Kuch bacteria apni cell wall ke bahar capsule banate hain. Yeh gelatinous (jelly jaisi) teh hai jo bacterial colonies ko chipchipa (sticky) bana deti hai.
Cell Membrane

Cell membrane ya plasma membrane cell wall ke bilkul neeche hoti hai. Jin bacteria mein cell wall nahin hoti (jaise mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas), un mein yehi sab se bahar wali teh hoti hai. Bacteria ki cell membrane ki chemical banawat mein sterols (jaise cholesterol) nahin hote. Kuch jagahon par cell membrane andar ki taraf mud jati hai (invaginate hoti hai) aur cytoplasm mein vesicles (chhoti thailiyan), tubules (nalkiyan) ya lamellae (patli tehen) banati hai. In banawaton ko mesosomes kehte hain. Yeh DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa lete hain aur respiratory centres (saans ke markaz) ka kaam bhi karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne “Sarcoplasmas” chhapa hai, lekin is naam ka koi bacterial group nahin. Bina cell wall wale bacteria mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas hain; kitab khud topic 2.6 mein yehi naam deti hai.

blocks.title: Mesosomes
blocks.text: Bacterial cell membrane ki andar ki taraf mudi hui tehen jo cytoplasm mein vesicles, tubules ya lamellae banati hain. Yeh DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa leti hain aur respiratory centres ka kaam karti hain; bacterium mein mitochondria nahin hote, is liye respiration cell membrane par hoti hai.
Cytoplasm aur Genetic Material

Cytoplasm mein ghule hue (dissolved) maddey aur bari banawatein hoti hain, jaise nucleoid, ribosomes aur mesosomes. Is mein cytoskeleton aur membrane-bounded organelles nahin hote. Bohat se ribosomes cytoplasmic matrix mein azaad bikhre hote hain aur kuch plasma membrane se dheele jure hote hain. Bacterial ribosomes eukaryotic ribosomes se chhote hote hain. Har ribosome 70S par sediment hota (neeche baithta) hai (bara subunit 50S aur chhota subunit 30S). Cytoplasm ke beech ke qareeb ek be-dhangi shakal ka ghana (dense) hissa hota hai, yani nucleoid. Is mein DNA hota hai. Bacterium mein ek hi, circular (gol), double stranded DNA hota hai. Bacterial DNA ke saath histones (khaas proteins) jure nahin hote. Ise kabhi kabhi bacterium ka chromosome kehte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: S (Svedberg unit) yeh batata hai ke centrifuge mein koi cheez kitni tezi se neeche baithti hai. Yeh size aur shakal dono par munhasir hai, is liye subunits ko jama nahin karte: 50S + 30S mil kar 70S ribosome bante hain, 80S nahin.

Kuch bacteria mein circular, double-stranded, extra chromosomal (chromosome se alag) DNA molecules hote hain jinhen plasmids kehte hain. Yeh self-replicating hain, yani khud apni copies banate hain, aur cell division se pehle ya baad mein replicate ho sakte hain. In mein aise genes hote hain jo bacteria ko na-mawafiq (unfavourable) halaat, jaise antibiotics, ke khilaf resistance (bardasht) dete hain.

Plasmids genetic engineering mein ahem vectors (genes le jane wali gaari) ka kaam bhi karte hain. In ke zariye chune hue genes bacteria tak pohanchaye jate hain, cloning ke liye ya khaas proteins banane ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko bohat si antibiotics se kyun bachati hai, aur phir khaas molecules is membrane se kaise guzarte hain?
blocks.explanation: Lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane patli peptidoglycan teh ke bahar ek extra rukawat (barrier) hai, is liye bohat si antibiotics andar apne nishane tak nahin pohanch paateen. Isi membrane mein porin proteins khaas molecules ke liye pores (soorakh) ka kaam karte hain, aur woh in se guzar jate hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Bacteria unicellular prokaryotes hain: membrane-bounded organelles nahin, saaf nucleus nahin.
Cell wall peptidoglycan (murein) ki hai: Gram-positive mein moti teh aur kam lipid; Gram-negative mein patli teh aur upar outer membrane (lipopolysaccharides, lipoproteins, porin).
Kuch bacteria cell wall ke bahar chipchipa capsule banate hain.
Cell membrane mein sterols nahin; is ki andar mudi tehen (mesosomes) DNA replication, cell division aur respiration mein madad karti hain.

Cytoplasm mein 70S ribosomes (50S + 30S); nucleoid mein ek circular double-stranded DNA, histones ke baghair; kuch bacteria mein plasmids jo resistance ke genes rakhte hain aur genetic engineering mein vectors bante hain.
